decisions.question: i18n coverage strategy and exact translated string set (P1-36)?
decisions.decision: Hybrid, as spec'd: (1) additive data-i18n attribute pass over static chrome walked by applyLang(); (2) stT('key')||'English' at the JS-generated renderHome labels (ownerLine L3162, hero net label L3186, 5 hero-stat captions, 6 quick-tile labels, empty-state L3273) because those re-render and would clobber an attribute. Curated ~40-key set = bottom nav, 8 config subtabs, settings-hub header, home section heads (Needs attention/Quick actions/Customer lookup/Greetings due today), hero footer, hero-stat + quick-tile labels, modules/reports/today headings, the two new card copies. Fallback chain stT()=dict[lang][key] ?? en[key] ?? null; applyLang skips null so hand-written English DOM is the ultimate fallback and is never blanked. textContent only (XSS-inert). Do NOT translate: brand/store names, dates, data-derived attention titles/msgs/ctas, CRO/GST tokens, module iframe content, or report content. Marathi/Hindi draft strings are PLACEHOLDERS pending native review (owner is Marathi-speaking).
decisions.rationale: Static chrome is parsed once and never regenerated — tagging + one applyLang pass translates it with zero render-function rewrites, honoring the 'preserve behaviour byte-for-byte / no large-span rewrite' hard rule. Only the small JS-generated label set needs stT() at assignment.

decisions.question: Attention stable-id scheme + dismiss/snooze semantics + re-appear (P1-38)?
decisions.decision: id = simpleHash(it.key||it.title) (simpleHash confirmed at L2148, digits-only → injection-safe in onclick). State key st_v5_attn_state_v1 = {v:1,dismissed:{id:'YYYY-MM-DD'},snoozed:{id:'YYYY-MM-DD'}}. DISMISS = suppress only while stored date===todayIso() (returns next calendar day if the condition recurs). SNOOZE = hide until stored future date; durations offered in modal = 1 day / 3 days / 1 week; Home 💤 one-tap default = 3 days. attnLoadState() GCs stale dismissed(!=today) and expired snoozed(<=today) and persists ONLY if GC mutated. Bell keeps the plain dot (no numeric badge) driven by post-filter __active.length. openAttention() is repointed from scroll-to-card to the Attention Centre modal (grep-confirmed sole caller at L1160).
decisions.rationale: Title already embeds area+emoji+numbers so a title-hash gives distinct ids without editing the ~12 push() sites; date-scoped dismiss delivers the required 'returns next day if still open' with a self-pruning tiny blob.

decisions.question: Can high-severity exceptions be buried by snooze/dismiss (P1-38 governance)?
decisions.decision: Red/high-sev items (the SB.exceptions sev==='high' rows unshifted at L3267, e.g. cash cross-check, overdue tax) remain DISMISSABLE for the current day only but snooze is CAPPED to a max of 1 day for them; medium/low get the full 1d/3d/1wk menu. attnSnooze clamps days to 1 when the item is high-sev.
decisions.rationale: Preserves the daily-return safety net for critical flags — they can be quieted for today but always resurface the next day — while still letting owners defer routine noise.

decisions.question: Text-size scale magnitude + chrome-only vs propagate (P1-39)?
decisions.decision: class html.st-textsize-large → single rule `#mainContent{zoom:1.12}`. Normal=no class=untouched. Chrome-content-only for v1: NOT propagated to module iframes (#moduleScreen is a separate fixed overlay) and NOT applied to body-level fixed surfaces (modal/toast/FAB). Two-step Normal/Large only.
decisions.rationale: zoom scales text+container together on this px-based design (root/body font-size would barely move); scoping to the #mainContent scroller keeps topbar/botnav/iframe pixel-identical with the least clipping risk. 1.12 (not 1.2) minimizes horizontal-overflow against .main overflow-x:hidden.

decisions.question: Weekly report: week window + new type vs filter (P1-47)?
decisions.decision: NEW report type weeklyBrief with a third scope value 'weekly' (not a weekly filter over existing builders). Window = Monday–Sunday ISO week CONTAINING opts.date. Comparison = fair same-span: current window = first nDays up to min(weekEnd,today), previous window = same nDays of the prior Mon-Sun week (week-to-date vs same point last week). All week date math uses a LOCAL isoOf() helper, never toISOString (IST off-by-one). pack('weekly') DEFERRED.
decisions.rationale: scope is pure hub metadata with no mechanism to pass granularity into a builder, and most daily builders read single-day snapshots that don't aggregate — a filter would force rewriting many builders (hard-rule violation). QMS via computeQmsDay is the one clean cross-day aggregator. Calendar-week anchoring makes every in-week date yield the same stable report.

decisions.question: Lost-walkin data source + scope (P1-45)?
decisions.decision: NEW report type lostWalkinCallSheet, scope 'monthly'. Reads retail_queue_management_v1.customers[] directly via J() (same as qmsReport), filters outcome /non.?purchase/i AND entryTime.slice(0,7)===month. Callable = last-10-digit mobile present; dedupe by that number keeping the newest visit; sort newest-first. No-number walk-ins EXCLUDED from the call list but COUNTED and disclosed via a KPI tile + footnote. Include ALL non-purchase (do not exclude rows that already have a scheduled follow-up) in v1.
decisions.rationale: Read-only, mirrors the proven qmsReport read pattern, no new key. Newest-first ordering satisfies the 'call warmest leads first' intent inside a clean monthly period the hub date-stepper already supports; excluding un-callable rows keeps the sheet actionable.
